# aap_eda_project (Resource)

Manages an EDA Project resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "aap_organization" "default" {
  name = "Default"
}

resource "aap_eda_project" "example" {
  name            = "My EDA Project"
  description     = "An example EDA project"
  url             = var.project_repo_url
  organization_id = data.aap_organization.default.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the EDA project.
- `organization_id` (Number) The organization ID for the EDA project.
- `url` (String) The SCM URL for the EDA project.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the EDA project.
- `proxy` (String) The proxy server for the EDA project.
- `scm_branch` (String) The SCM branch for the EDA project.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the EDA project.
